purpose: Absolute set-to-X tuning baselines, so a move card can show a real number (not just a direction) for ANY car — including undriven ones — selected by live DrivetrainType + CarClass + tire compound. Values are cross-corroborated across independent vetted guides (see [[fh6-external-tuning-sources]]); they are GENERIC starting points, overridden per-car by measured telemetry (e.g. mechanical_balance) once a car is driven. Tag anything sourced here 'baseline-generic'.
sources: gamingpromax (MB 0.55-0.65/~0.60, diff baselines, damping 18/6, aero 0.40-0.45, PSI-by-compound), forza.guide (spring freq 2.80/2.90 Hz, 4-phase model), grindout (build/tune order), forzatune (caster/camber). Two web sources had errors that were excluded (grindout bump~=60%*rebound; vpesports diff direction).

FWD.note: front diff only; accel higher to reduce exit understeer

RWD.note: rear diff; higher accel = more traction but exit push

AWD.note: center 60-90% rear (never <50); RWD-like character with AWD traction

mech_balance_by_class._note: higher classes tolerate a slightly more front-biased (sharper) balance; window is 0.55-0.65

psi_by_compound._note: grippier/stiffer-sidewall compounds want more air to hold patch shape; off-road/rally want less for compliance
